svg.aria-label: The parts v1 touches, a row for each v1 step, and a note beside each: search over SMP; paying in the store, whose receipt becomes a prepaid code; registering a new name in two steps a minute apart, hidden then shown; moving a site-bought name in, three transactions that change its owner; paying in the browser for a prepaid code the buyer never sees, after the app's own steps; keeping a name on the site or a dApp, pointed at the profile, which the app shows once it opens this address.
svg.text: Over SMP, not the website: more private.
2 · Pay in the store, then register as in row 3
1 · receipt + sealed order with its code
2 · then the name, as row 3's step 2
The receipt becomes a prepaid code (decided).
The order goes in two requests: the payment with
the sealed order, then the name.
The first is answered in two parts:
a refused order keeps the payment.

g.text: 3 · Register a new name with a prepaid code
step 1: sealed order, name hidden
sent; SimpleX pays
step 2, a minute later: the name
sent; SimpleX pays
the name, owned by the app's wallet
Hidden for a minute, so that nobody watching the
blockchain can take it first. The service sees it at step 2.
The prepaid code goes with the order, as it is.
4 · Move in a name bought on the site
the user brings the name code
step 1 · the old owner allows the move
sent; SimpleX pays
step 2 · the app's wallet accepts the terms
sent; SimpleX pays
step 3 · the app's wallet takes the name
sent; SimpleX pays
Not a new registration: only the owner changes.
The name code is the old owner's key: it stays on the
device. The app signs all three; SimpleX sends and pays.
In v1 a name moves in once.
5 · Pay in the browser, then register as in row 3
after key and checkout in the app: a link with only the code's hash
is the code paid? then row 3
paid: a link brings the app forward
F-Droid, desktop; iOS and Google Play in the US only.
Skips row 4's three transactions.
To build: the invoice in the service,
its page on the site, and the link back.
6 · Keep the name on the site or a dApp
link edited
Show on your profile: what does it open?
this profile's address, so the name shows
As testing names work today: the name stays in
its wallet, and its links are edited there.
The app shows it once it opens this address.
